notes: Only four directives are waste. The labelled KEEPs are a representative sample of the dense body; the case-level must_keep_nouns list covers the unlabelled remainder, so a broad cut is caught even where no label sits.

labels.text: Run everything through make. Bare python invocations miss the PYTHONPATH shim.
DAGs must be importable in under 2 seconds. The scheduler kills slow imports and the DAG silently disappears.
Never use datetime.now() in a DAG — use logical_date, or backfills produce different data.
catchup=False on every new DAG unless the DAG is explicitly a backfill.
Task retries: 2 for Snowflake, 0 for Kafka. Kafka producers are not idempotent yet.
Cross-DAG dependencies go through ExternalTaskSensor with poke_interval=300. Do not use TriggerDagRunOperator.
Secrets come from atlas/airflow in Vault via platform.secrets.get. Never read os.environ directly in a DAG.
Incremental models must declare unique_key and use merge. insert_overwrite silently drops late rows.
Never dbt run --full-refresh against prod without a ticket. It rebuilds 4 TB and costs about $900.
Snowflake warehouse for dev is WH_DEV_XS. Anything larger needs finance approval.
Entity keys are strings, always. Integer keys break the Redis online store's key encoding.
Backfills are not idempotent — check features/_state/ for a prior run before starting.
Online and offline definitions live in the same file on purpose. Do not split them.
Set the seed with platform.seed.set_all(seed). Torch, numpy and CUDA all need it.
Checkpoint every 500 steps to s3://atlas-checkpoints/. Spot instances are reclaimed with two minutes' notice.
A training run that touches customer data needs --consent-cohort set.
Terraform: make tf-plan ENV=staging. Never run terraform directly — the wrapper injects state backend and assume-role.
prod applies only from CI on main. A local apply will be reverted and will page on-call.
If a run dies mid-apply, do not force-unlock — ask in #atlas-platform.
Runbooks: docs/runbooks/<alert-name>.md. Every alert must have one before it can page.
Escalation path is in PagerDuty, not here.
To silence an alert use the PagerDuty maintenance window. Do not comment out the alert definition.
Python 3.12, ruff and mypy --strict in CI. Type annotations on every public function.
Write clean, readable code and follow best practices.
Tests: make test runs unit tests; make test-integration needs Docker and takes 8 minutes.
Be thorough and take care when making changes to shared code.
Commit messages: <domain>: <imperative>, where domain is one of the six top-level directories.
Please read this file before starting work, and follow all the guidelines it contains.
